audience: Rest Is History listeners -- curious, Anglophone, well-read, not academic
optimisation_target: subject-matter variety (the launch review's complaint was a narrow month: rulers, commanders, clergy, war, religion, death). Gender is recorded, never selected on.

odnb.description: Oxford Dictionary of National Biography (Wikidata P1415); 24,276 dead + image + enwiki. One stratum per occupation.

adb.description: Australian Dictionary of Biography (P1907); 4,817 dead + image + enwiki. Pulled whole.

dib.description: Dictionary of Irish Biography (P6829); 2,748 dead + image + enwiki. Pulled whole.

nzpacific.description: New Zealand / Pacific: Te Ara-DNZB (P2745, verified live) plus nationality, birthplace and ethnic-group fallbacks for pre-colonial figures.

occupations.description: Worldwide Wikidata occupation families, no dictionary or nationality filter -- the direct fix for the 32%-statesmen skew.

inourtime.description: BBC Radio 4 'In Our Time' episode list (1,108 rows) -- resolved to Wikidata, humans only.
